sentences.text: CORAM: HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE RAJESH KUMAR VERMA  ORAL ORDER 5 19-06-2023 Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and the learned A.P.P. for the State.

The petitioner seeks bail, who is in custody since 03.01.2022 in connection with Jehanabad Mahila P.S. Case No. 30 of 2021, F.I.R. dated 02.07.2021 registered for the offence punishable under Sections 498A, 341 and 323/34 of IPC and Section 3/4 of Dowry Prohibition Act.

entities.text: Jehanabad Mahila P.S. Case No. 30 of 2021
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: In view of the report of the learned Mediator dated 14.06.2023 it appears that the amicable settlement has been made between the parties.
In view of the aforesaid, the provisional bail granted to the petitioner by order dated 03.01.2023 is hereby confirmed.
Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.29591 of 2022(5) dt.19-06-2023
Accordingly, this application stands disposed of.

(Rajesh Kumar Verma, J) Nitesh/-

opennyai_summary.decision:
The petitioner seeks bail, who is in custody since 03.01.2022 in connection with Jehanabad Mahila P.S. Case No. 30 of 2021, F.I.R. dated 02.07.2021 registered for the offence punishable under Sections 498A, 341 and 323/34 of IPC and Section 3/4 of Dowry Prohibition Act.

In view of the aforesaid, the provisional bail granted to the petitioner by order dated 03.01.2023 is hereby confirmed.
Accordingly, this application stands disposed of.
